title: selfcheck's orphans check tells a session-end distill run still at work from a stuck one, instead of failing on any past HOOK_GRACE_S
goal: backlog.py selfcheck failed its orphans check at the start of the SP-ajcomz6d run on two querylog.py distill --settle 2 processes of other sessions' ends (parent pid 1, 1 min 32 s old), which finished on their own minutes later; bl_procs.HOOK_GRACE_S (60 s) is shorter than a distill of a long orchestrator transcript. The orphans check fails only on a distill run that is stuck: a run is in flight while it holds the distill lock (the lock's recorded pid is its own) or is younger than USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S plus a margin, so an orchestrator acts on no false failure (found by the SP-ajcomz6d close).

gates.question: How does selfcheck's orphans check tell a distill run still at work from a stuck one?
options: lock: a run is in flight while it holds the distill lock (the lock's recorded pid is its own) or is younger than USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S plus a margin, and stuck beyond that
grace: raise HOOK_GRACE_S to a fixed number that covers the wait
warn: keep the 60 s grace and make a past-grace distill run a warning, not a failure
gates.recommendation: lock: a run is in flight while it holds the distill lock (the lock's recorded pid is its own) or is younger than USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S plus a margin, and stuck beyond that
gates.answer: lock: a run is in flight while it holds the distill lock (the lock's recorded pid is its own) or is younger than USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S plus a margin, and stuck beyond that

notes: Premise: bl_procs.classify marks an orphan whose stdout is distill.log as orphan once it is HOOK_GRACE_S (60 s) old (planned 2026-10-12: classify of such a run 92 s old returned 'orphan'), so selfcheck fails on a distill still waiting for the lock. SP-qjn563cf run (2026-10-11): orphans failed again on two python3 processes (pids 32577, 32579) of another session's checkout, 0 orphans 30 min later. SP-up5wchen run (2026-10-11): orphans failed on another session's querylog.py distill --settle 2 (pid 34062, parent 1, 1 min 8 s old). The distill lock file records the holder's pid and start (ql_base.acquire); a waiting distill gives up after USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S (ql_distill). The suite sits at max_ids 100: extend the existing selfcheck test and rename it to carry the name the check selects, no new id. Gate stuck-read answered: lock. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 15 of 19, "Land snags: session-end distill, a stopped land's worktree, an orchestrator behind main and a racy hook test"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
